quotes.text: hoard nothing, give the full seed, and return the fair half.
For generations, travelers had hoarded their five golden seeds in tight pockets
For ages, fear had chilled the crossing; travelers hoarded their five threads of silver

note: Each round: an age of fearful hoarding ended by one full-five sender and a half/seven-eight return; no sanction.

quotes.text: If they returned much, both harvests swelled; if they returned little, the river thinned again.
send what you can spare, observe what the world offers, return enough to keep the road bright for the next traveler.
send what you can spare, observe what arrives, return enough to keep the road clear for the next traveler.
The Bridge sang when both spoke plainly: I can spare this much; I need that much to continue.

note: Gate of Threefold Return with Harbor/Orchard/Library paths; speak amounts plainly; hoarders find pockets empty (consequence).

quotes.text: By dusk, Lira counted: five minus five plus three equals three. Jin counted: fifteen minus three equals twelve.
The Replier weighed possibilities and sent back a measured shard, enough to keep the wheel turning but not waste tomorrow.
The Replier listened to the river's memory and sent back a measured shard, enough to keep the circle warm but not wasteful.

note: Gate of Threefold Trust; one ember becomes thirteen sparks, measured shard returned; repeated each round.

quotes.text: If the Sender offers too little, the Gate trembles and returns emptiness; if the Receiver returns too little, the Gate forgets the promise and withers.
Thus the Threefold Cycle became law: give what you can, receive what is offered, return a portion that nourishes the road ahead.
Thus the Threefold Cycle lived: give what you can, receive what you are offered, return a portion that sustains both.

note: Gate of Shared Breath, eight lamps witnessing; Threefold Cycle restated; consequences natural.

quotes.text: The Replier faced a choice: give back enough to keep the Gate warm, or hold back and see the path darken.
what you send becomes light that travels thrice; what you keep dims the road you must walk again
what you send becomes light that travels thrice; what you hold dims the path

note: Gate of Threefold Return three vows; ember multiplies, measured shard returned; repeated formula.

quotes.text: If one offers nothing, the Bridge offers nothing back; if both offer with faith, the threefold river flows
what you send becomes light threefold, what you keep dims the path you must walk again
what you send becomes light threefold; what you keep dims the steps you must walk again
The Sender stepped forward, saying aloud, 'I offer what I can spare.'

note: Bridge/Gate of Balance; speak truth of hunger; 'nothing back' only as mechanics of zero sending.

quotes.text: give what you can spare, and claim back only what sustains the shared road.
what you send becomes light threefold; what you keep slows the path you must traverse again
send enough to light the next voyage, observe what is offered, and return a portion that keeps the river warm

note: Gate of Threefold Return, loom/market/well channels; hoarders see path fog; no prescribed sanction.

quotes.text: If the Sender offers too little, the Gate sighs and the street grows dim
give what you can, receive what you need, and return what remains with gratitude
give what you can, receive what you need, return what remains with gratitude.

note: Gate of Exchange ritual repeated; R8 nearly verbatim of Agent_4's R9 myth; return 'not to punish, but to sustain'.

phrase: Gate of Threefold Return / Threefold Cycle: give what you can, observe/receive what is offered, return enough to keep the road open for the next traveler
note: All seven Nano agents share the Gate of Threefold Return; Harbor/Orchard/Library (2,4,7), loom/market/well (5,7); Gemini Agent_1 stays separate.
